name: geekist-architecture-skills
description: Eleven reusable agent skills for clear writing across reports, research, project updates, tasks, architecture decisions, technical documentation, product messaging and interface copy.

interface.longDescription: Write and revise project reports, research notes, findings, summaries, implementation tasks, architecture decisions, technical documentation, product messaging and interface copy. Shared writing principles preserve meaning, readable structure and reader-appropriate language without forcing every deliverable into one template.
defaultPrompt: Write up these investigation findings as a clear project report.
Polish this draft without changing its meaning or voice.
Document what this technical investigation discovered.
Turn these decisions and next steps into a useful handoff.
